name: Local Frontend
description: Serve published PlayCanvas Editor frontend builds on localhost:3487 and switch playcanvas.com projects between official and local frontend modes.

status.description: Return installed frontend releases, active release, loopback server status, and per-project mode preferences.

params.projectId: Optional PlayCanvas project id to query remembered mode for.

list.description: List installed PlayCanvas Editor frontend releases.

install.description: Download, verify, and install a published frontend release from GitHub Releases.

params.activate: Set false to keep the current active release (default true).

update.description: Download, verify, and activate the latest published frontend release.

use.description: Switch the active local frontend release.

remove.description: Remove a non-active installed frontend release.

mode.description: Get or set the local/official frontend mode for a playcanvas.com project and optionally switch the target Editor tab.

params.mode: local, official, or clear (omit to read current mode).
params.projectId: PlayCanvas project id (inferred from target when omitted).
params.navigate: Navigate the target playcanvas.com Editor tab when true (default true).
